balls.text: another full delivery driven down the ground to long on, good running, gets the second run.
full delivery and hit in the air over the bowler to long off.
on a length and Suman flicks it high in the air to deep midwicket.
yorker squeezed out back to the bowler, good bowling from Harwood.
low full toss and Smith hits in the air down the ground straight into the hands of Warne at long on.
too full and in the slot, hit hard in the air down the ground to long off fence.
yorker dug out back to the bowler.
worked through the onside for a single.
slow short delivery and Smith gets hit on the helmet as he plays too early.
dropped, full delivery lofted in the air to long off and Raut running in to take the catch drops it.
full delivery driven down to long off.
squeezed out to short fine leg, clumsy fielding by Harwood allowing the run.
yorker dug out to the off side.

keeps it full once again, played out to deep midwicket, Asnodkar fields and wanted to try a relay but his partner Smith was not even looking and the batsmen scamper through for an extra run and Harwood is not happy.
another delivery right in the block-hole, digs it out to the off side beside the track, this time they get the single.
good delivery right in the block-hole, dug out back to the bowler.
not a well timed shot outside the off stump, plays to cover for a single.
short and wayward delivery down the leg side, pulls it well down to fine leg fence.
slower delivery pulled to deep midwicket for a single.
fuller delivery outside the off stump and Rohit looking to go down the ground, gets the leading edge very high in the air to mid-off, where Warne judges it well and takes a good catch.
far too many slower deliveries from Trivedi, this time Rohit picked his spot and pulls it high and over the midwicket fence for maximum.
stands in the crease and lofts it in the air and one bounce to long off.
another slow short delivery and Rohit had to wait for the ages and then he pulls it down to long leg for a single.
a slow short delivery wide outside the off stump, mistimes the cut behind point.
driven down the ground to long off for a single.
down the leg side, Rohit looking to be cheeky, lets it go, but no wide signalled.
tossed up outside the leg stump, comes down the track and pushes to mid-on.
drags it too short, pulls it well in the air over midwicket to the fence.
comes down the track and squeezes it out to backward point.
uses his feet and works it through the onside for a single.
full and on the stumps, Suman gets behind the line and punches it down to long-on, gets it fine and that gives them enough time to come back for the second
defended down towards cover point, fielder moves across quickly and cuts off the single
slower delivery and that's worked away through midwicket. Single brings up the 100 for the Chargers
short and drifting down the leg side, Sharma moves across a bit and pulls it down to the fine leg fence - as easy as it gets

fuller length delivery and that is driven towards midwicket, Suman back-up too much, the throw misses the stumps at the bowler's end and Suman makes it back safely. Munaf attempts to kick the ball on to the stumps but ends up breaking the stumps with his foot. They go upstairs and all is sorted
in the slot on the middle and leg stump line, Sharma lines it up and lofts it over the midwicket fence, good clean hit
opens the face of the bat and runs it down to third man for a single
quicker delivery down the leg side and Sharma leaves it through to the keeper
punched away well in front of square leg this time, walking single added to the total
turned away behind square on the leg side
worked away on the leg side, again just a single
flat delivery, Suman comes down the track and misses it completely and the keeper misses an easy stumping chance
comes down the track and drives it down to long-on for an easy single
full and drifting down the leg side, rightly called a wide
tossed up close to the off stump line, Suman leans well forward and defends it with a straight bat.
cut away off the back-foot and they scamper through for a single
driven down to long-on for a single, good over so far for the chargers
short and cut away straight to the fielder at point
another gutsy shot - Once again Suman comes down the track to the pitch of the delivery and this time he hammers it over the long-on fence
shot! tossed up and turning away, Suman dances down the track, nicely gets to the pitch of the delivery and lofts it inside out to the extra cover fence
flat and on the stumps, Suman drives it down to long-on, end of a decent over
wayward delivery down the leg side
worked away off the pads to fine leg for a single
another fuller length delivery and Suman too drives it down to long-off for a single, this is turning out to be another good over from the Royals
driven down to long-off, again just a single
fuller length delivery, Sharma gets behind the line and punches hard but fails to get it past the fielder at short cover
defended outside the off stump
fuller length delivery, driven away on the leg side for an easy single
worked away on the leg side
edged down to short fine leg, no room for a single there
a rare short delivery, Suman rocks back and pulls it away to deep midwicket, they taken on the fielder in the deep and scamper through for the second
drifting on to the pads and that's whipped down to fine leg for an easy single
punched off the back-foot to cover point
punched down to mid-on, Sharma takes off for the single but Suman is not interested.
Yusuf! full and on the stumps, Gilchrist drives across towards short midwicket where Pathan dives low to his right and takes a stunner. Jadeja nets the big fish.
punched down to long-on
drifting in from outside the leg stump, Gilchrist quickly goes down on one knee and slogs it away to deep square leg, again just a single
full and on the pads, swept away nicely to deep fine leg for an easy single
fulltoss on the pads and Gilchrist drives it down to long-on
comes down the track and drives it through midwicket
pitched on middle and leg and turning down the leg side, wide called
perfect! once again Gilchrist comes down the track, this time gets right behind the line and lofts it straight back down the track and the ball sails over the long-on fence
forced away towards point
comes down the track and swings across the line but fails to make contact, ball clips the pad and runs away on the off side
flatter trajectory, Gilchrist quickly gets into position and works it away towards square leg
tossed up and turning away from the right-hander, Sharma stays back and works it away on the leg side
pitched up close to the off stump line, Gilchrist punches it down to mid-off
runs off the pad to the square leg region and the batsmen cross over for a quick single
punched off the front-foot to short cover, Warne there moves across and stop it with one hand
good length delivery on the middle and leg stump line, Sharma gets behind the line and defends it down
short of a good length delivery on the pads, Gilchrist pulls hard but fails to connect properly, ball runs down to fine leg off the edge
worked away for an easy single
swept away fine, Gilchrist was interested in a single but Sharma was not. End of a brilliant spell from Pathan. Gave away 17 in his first two overs but the next two overs went for just 2.
forced away off the back-foot to the cover region, diving stop at short cover saves runs
swept away hard but straight to the fielder at short fine leg
defended down on the off side, this is good bowling from Yusuf.
worked away from middle and leg to the midwicket region, fielder moves across quickly and cuts off the single
worked away off the pads to the square leg region for an easy single

again slightly shorty and Gilchrist pulls it away well in front of square leg, long chase from the fielder at square leg ends in vain. The shot was not timed well enough but Gilly got just enough bat on it
bowled from round the stump, good length and this one came in a touch. Gilchrist plays it safe by leaving it through to the keeper
slightly short and angling away from the left-hander, Gilchrist goes after it and is beaten comprehensively
line and length delivery and Gilchrist works it away on the leg side
good length delivery and Gilchrist defends it down

And he strikes first ball! Two slips in place and Harwood pitches it short of a length, the one that comes in with the angle. Bilakhia goes for the pull but gets nowhere, more of an instinctive shot. Ball clips the top edge and balloons up towards mid-on where Trivedi makes no mistake. It's a dream start
flat delivery from Pathan and Gilchrist looking to pull, mistimes to mid-on.
short from Pathan, pulls in the air through square leg to the deep.
moves forward and pushes down the ground to mid-off.
sweeps from way outside the off stump and misses, gets hit on the pad outside the line.
moves back and defends to the onside.

flatter delivery from Pathan and Gibbs looking to swing it across the line, misses it and gets hit on the pad, loud appeal and given by the umpire, Gibbs is furious with the decision and he keeps speaking as he walks off.
off the pad to short fine leg.
looking to sweep again, off the pad to the onside.
pushed to the onside.
sweeps again, but this time a top edge and the ball flies over the short fine leg for couple more.
sweeps and connects well past the short fine leg and to the fence, the fielder running around fails to field it.
on the middle and leg, turns it behind square leg.
quicker delivery from Pathan and Gilchrist back in the crease, plays square of the wicket on the off side.
again takes it on the pad as he looks to work it to the onside.
goes for the big shot and gets the outside edge down to third man fence.
takes it on the pad, looking to work it to the onside, question asked but turned down as it was pitching outside the leg stump.
down the wicket and drives in the gap between mid-off and extra cover and no stopping that.
works it to short fine leg for a single.
gets behind a short of a length delivery and defends with an angled bat to gully.
that is maximum, a wonderful strike, too short from Munaf, hooks it high and over the long leg fence.
gets behind the back of a length delivery and defends to the off side.
picks up the length this time and pulls it on the front foot and hits it high and one bounce to the midwicket fence.
cuts and misses outside the off stump, through to the keeper, extra bounce.
back of a length delivery outside the off stump and Gilchrist has a slash at it and gets beaten, good carry to the keeper.
another full delivery driven to mid-off, silly fielding allows the single.
another half-volley, but this time driven straight to the fielder at extra cover.
that is the first boundary, it was in the slot outside the off stump and he drives in the gap wide of the fielders through extra cover.
looking to work it to the onside, gets a leading edge down to third man, closing the face off the bat too early.
turns it behind square leg to get off the mark.
flat and straight outside the off stump, trying to run it down to third man, gets beaten.
pushes back to the bowler, Edwards gets some hand to it, deflects to mid-off, shy at the stumps from Smith misses the stumps, another run out chance missed and Rajasthan Royals win.

good short delivery and Harwood misses the ball and through to Gilchrist, they are running for a bye, Gilchrist throws the ball along the track and Edwards gets in between the ball and the stumps and drops the ball, misses a good run out chance.
cuts and gets the edge outside the off stump and Gilchrist does well to stop it.
a tight line on the off and middle, pushes to cover and looking for the single, not there.
clips it behind square leg and Rohit Sharma running in, misfields it completely and the ball rolls into the fence for a boundary, a terrible mistake.
full toss, gets an edge to the off side.
good ball right in the block-hole, can only dig it out back to the bowler.
full ball driven down the ground to long on.

full ball driven to mid-off, Edward throws the ball and Smith does something with his hand, referred to the third umpire, NOT OUT comes up on the screen as the bails had been dislodged by Smith's hand.
off the pad to short fine leg.
fuller delivery outside the off stump and Pathan looking for the big shot, gets the leading edge high in the air on the off side and Gibbs judges it well to take the catch at point.
again too short, pulled to deep midwicket.
fuller delivery driven hard back down the track, hits the stumps and deflects to long on, that was hit with lot of power.
too short from RP Singh, pulled along the ground to deep midwicket.
another short delivery, hammered down the ground to long off, wonderful running, comes quickly back for the second run.
short ball cut to the sweeper for a single.
full delivery driven down the ground to long on for a single.
short ball and pulled away nicely and finds the perfect gap between the fine leg fielder and deep backward square leg.
good ball in the block-hole, dug out to the onside, Edwards has a shy at the stumps and misses, good backing up at mid-off.
terrible delivery on the pads, Raut only has to get a tickle and the ball runs down to the fence.
off the pad as he looks to work it through the onside.
full toss driven down the ground to long off.
plays and misses outside the off stump as he tries to run the ball down to third man.
slower delivery from Shoaib, Pathan needs no invitation, pulls well high and over the midwicket fence for another maximum.
goes all the way, he strikes it nicely, lofts it high and over extra cover for maximum.
played square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
slower delivery played in the air behind square leg for a single.
back of a length delivery worked to the vacant midwicket for a single.
line and length delivery, Yusuf stretches forward and plays it back down the track. End of a decent spell from Ojha
goes for the sweep but fails to make contact
defended back down the track
full and down the leg side, Yusuf goes for the sweep and the ball races away past the keeper to the fence, looks like it got a touch on it as it is signaled a boundary
turned away off the pads to the square leg region

And Warne throws it away! He charges down to Ojha and unleashes a wild swing, ball clips the edge and balloons up towards short cover, Gilchrist calls for it and nicely settles under it. Could this be a turning point?
pulled away just wide of the fielder at short fine leg and they rush through for a well judged single
good length delivery on the middle and leg stump line, Raut shuffles across and works it away behind square on the leg side
short and wide outside the off stump, Warne leans back and cuts it away well in front of point
excellent off-cutter, Warne fails to pick it up and in the end leaves it through to the keeper
worked away on the leg side for an easy single
good length delivery outside the off stump and Raut punches it away towards cover
defended to cover, no room for a single there
pitched outside the off stump and turning away, Warne plays across the line, trying to get it away to the vacant midwicket region, but gets beaten all ends up
driven straight back down the track to the long-on region
bit of extra bounce and turning away from the right-hander, Warne stands tall on the back-foot and plays it away well in front of point
full and down the leg side, swept away to fine leg for a single
worked away from outside the off stump to the midwicket region
short and wide outside the off stump, Raut goes for the cut but fails to make contact
drifting on to middle and leg, Raut goes down on one knee and paddles it down to the vacant fine leg fence - this is turning out to be a big over
swept away behind square on the leg side
another one! powerful slog sweep and the ball files off the meat of the bat and over the midwicket fence. Rao straightaway pays for the dropped chance - could that drop cost the Chargers the game?
dropped! full and driven straight back, as easy as it gets but Rao fails to hold on to it. What a miss
flat delivery outside the off stump and Warne powers it away to the midwicket fence, powerful shot
driven away to wide long-on, another single added to the total
pushes forward and gets hit on the pad, loud appeal for lbw tuned down - looked close
worked away through square leg
edged and through! flat delivery outside the off stump. Raut pokes at it, away from his body and the thick edge runs down to third man
full and on the pads, driven down to long-on, again just the single
on the stumps, worked away towards mid wicket for a single
played off the back-foot, ball clips the inside edge and runs down to third man

big inside edge and umpire Asnani upholds an LBW shout! Rao fires one in and Carseldine goes back to cut, ball clips the inside edge and thuds into the pad - loud appeal for lbw and the finger goes up. That was one of the biggest inside edge I have seen given out, he smashed it on to the pad. To make matters worse, the ball after taking the edge, hit the pad outside the line of the leg stump.
short delivery on the middle and leg stump line, Warne stays back and pulls it away to deep fine leg - just a single
slightly short and close to the off stump line, Carseldine makes room and cuts it away to deep backward point
worked away off the pads to the fine leg reigon

And Jadeja departs! Rao starts off with a fuller delivery on the middle and off stump line, bowled from round the wicket. Jadeja comes down the track and lofts it straight to Dwyane Smith at long-on, the idea was to go over the fielder but ...
driven away wide of the fielder at long-on, easy single to end the over
cut away off the back-foot to deep point and the single brings up the 50 partnership, well played
strayingt down the leg side and that's a wide
close to the off stump line, Carseldine makes room and cuts hard, ball clips the outside edge and races away to the third man fence, lucky runs
driven down to long-off for an easy single
driven away nicely off the back-foot but the ball finds the fielder at short third man
worked away off the pads to the fine leg reigon
on the middle and leg stump line, Jadeja tries to work it away but fails to make contact
quicker delivery and Jadeja is beaten outside the off stump
Max! Jadeja comes down the track and lofts one over the long-on fence, just managed to get it over Smith there. Close call but six runs added to the total
turned away off the back-foot to the square leg reigon
bowled from over the stumps and drifting down leg, that's a wide
punched off the back-foot to the cover region
starts off with a short delivery on the middle and leg stump line, Carseldine sways back and pulls it down to fine leg
pitched up outside the off stump and that's driven straight back past the bowler to long-off for a single
punched away off the back-foot to deep backward point, again just the single
swept away straight to the fielder at short fine leg
full and on the pads, Jadeja tries to work it away on the leg side and ends up with a leading edge to short fine leg
driven off the back-foot to deep point, easy single
bit of width offered outside the off stump and that's driven away to deep backward point for a brace
Carseldine moves away towards leg and RP follows him nicely, in the end the ball is played down to mid-on and they scamper through for a dangerous single.
short rising delivery down the leg side, no-ball called for overstepping and the next ball will be a free-hit
RP drifts down leg and Carseldine nicely works it away to the fine leg fence. Diving effort in the deep ends in vain
good length delivery outside the off stump, defended
short delivery, pitched outside the off stump and angling in, Carseldine gets behind the line and taps it away on the leg side

shot! short rising delivery outside the off stump, Carseldine stands tall on the back-foot and punches it into the gap between mid-off and cover. He got right on top of the bounce and the placement was spot on
short of a good length delivery, touch outside the off stump and Carseldine watchfully taps it away towards cover
fuller delivery driven to mid-on.
good ball back of a length, Caseldine is lucky as he looks to force the ball through the off side, gets an inside edge past the stumps to fine leg fence.
short outside the off stump and Carseldine swings into action, cuts hard over backward point to the fence.
pushes it to the right of Smith, who quickly gets across to field the ball.
drives on the front foot to cover but cannot find the gap.
nice drive from Carseldine as he plays past the diving mid-off to the fence.
short delivery angled in and Jadeja gets his bat out of the way as he sways away.
walks down the track and RP Singh cramps the batsman once again, wonderful bowling RP Singh.
short delivery, up on his toes and defends with an angled bat to gully.
fuller outside the off stump, tries to squeeze it out, misses the bat and through to the keeper.
back of a length delivery angled into the thigh pad, nudges it down to fine leg.
plays and misses outside the off stump, a tentative Jadeja, nice shape from RP Singh.
good length delivery and on target, Carseldine defends with a straight bat down the track.
full and straight from Edwards, pushed back down the track and the ball hits the stumps.
full toss hit hard to covers, Jadeja quickly calls for a second run.
short delivery outside the off stump, goes for the pull and gets beaten.
cut hard but well stopped by Gibbs at short point, good anticipation.
fuller and bit wide outside the off stump, left alone.
cut hard to Gibbs at short point, the fielder was well placed there by Gilchrist as Ojha was looking to cut each and every delivery, well done.
back of a length delivery cut behind point.
good bowling from RP Singh, cramps him and Ojha is forced to block the ball.
another delivery angled across outside the off stump, another slash and gets beaten.
extra bounce and off the glove to the off side.
slashes and gets beaten outside the off stump.
watches it closely and lets the ball go through to the keeper.
left alone outside the off stump.
works it to deep square leg for couple of runs.

back of a length delivery and Asnodkar pushes softly to the off side and Carseldine comes on for the single, Asnodkar responds very late and Gibbs picks up the ball and throws it to RP Singh, who runs the batsman out.
a bouncer and Asnodkar ducks under it, signalled a wide as it goes above his head.
short outside the off stump and Smith upper cuts high in the air and down to third man and Shoaib takes the catch low in front of him.
run out missed, works forward of square leg and Smith takes off for a single, Asnodkar does not respond at all, the throw comes in but misses the stumps at the strikers end.
